patterns.note: Full-bleed hero image dominates the viewport, with key branding and calls to action overlaid directly on the visual content.
A bold, condensed display sans-serif is used for primary branding and headlines, contrasting with a more legible, modern sans-serif for navigation and detailed information.
High-contrast, almost brutalist color blocking with a vibrant, almost neon orange footer and an electric blue call-to-action button against a rich, photographic background.

The main background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect as the user scrolls, while a prominent, full-width footer section slides up from the bottom of the screen to reveal contact and legal information.
The site is structured as a single, impactful hero section followed by a distinct, high-contrast footer that reveals on scroll, with navigation elements sticky at the top.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-bleed background image, likely rendered via WebGL/Three.js for subtle parallax and potential interactive effects, with text elements positioned absolutely over it. A dark overlay or text shadows are used for readability against varying image tones.
The main navigation and logo at the top of the page are implemented as sticky elements, remaining visible as the user scrolls down.
A vibrant, full-width footer section is initially off-screen and animates into view from the bottom as the user scrolls, creating a clear visual break and revealing secondary information.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, condensed display headings (~4-5x body) create a strong visual impact, complemented by smaller, highly legible sans-serif text for navigation and details.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant, with a single instance of a pill-shaped button for the primary call to action.
design_tokens.spacing: An airy, expansive hero section provides ample breathing room around the central message, contrasting with a more densely packed footer for contact and legal information.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its bold, almost confrontational use of high-contrast, vibrant colors (electric orange and blue) against a high-fidelity, full-bleed food photograph. This creates an immediate, memorable visual identity that feels both modern and slightly rebellious, eschewing typical restaurant website aesthetics.
